hana: Hey folks  first day on runtime. Building from source on my ThinkPad with an external RTX 4080. Running `./scripts/build.sh --cuda` and hit a ptxas error. Anyone have a quick pointer? @kevin

kevin: welcome! :wave: Can you paste `nvcc --version` and the ptxas snippet and what distro youre on?

hana: nvcc:
``
nvcc: NVIDIA (R) Cuda compiler driver
Cuda compilation tools, release 11.8, V11.8.89
``
ptxas:
``
[ 12%] Building CUDA object src/runtime/CMakeFiles/runtime_cuda.dir/dispatch_kernels.cu.o
ptxas fatal   : ValueError: Unsupported gpu architecture 'compute_88'
CMake Error at cmake/FindCUDA.cmake:1455 (message):
  ptxas died with status 1
```

kevin: 4080 is Lovelace-family; nvcc 11.8 doesn't like `compute_88`. Two easy fixes: upgrade to a CUDA 12 dev image or force cmake to use integer archs. Try:
``
export CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=88
rm -rf build && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build -j8
```
That will emit `sm_88` codegen instead of the literal `compute_88` token that trips older ptxas.

infra-bot: Recommended developer image: redwood/dev:cuda-12-2025 (CUDA 12.2) for 40xx GPUs. Using the container avoids host toolkit/driver drift.

hana: Tried the env var, got past ptxas but hit a linker error due to mixed cuDNN on my host. Pulled the docker image and rebuilt inside container  build succeeded! :tada:

hana: I'll open a tiny PR for docs/dev-setup.md with the exact nvcc output, ptxas snippet, and the commands I ran. Tag: `chore(dev): clarify lovelace arch for new hires` and ping dev-experience.

devex-bot: Suggestion: add a one-liner to the onboarding checklist recommending the dev image for 40xx GPUs and the `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` env fallback.
